A layout-table row keeps an image as Markdown instead of degrading it to alt text

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<table><tr><td><img src=\"a.svg\" alt=\"A\"> <a href=\"/1\">x</a></td><td><a href=\"/2\">y</a></td></tr><tr><td><a href=\"/3\">z</a></td></tr></table>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
